headline: Approved retaining $1,250,000 in contingency fund, returning $533,811 to taxpayers, and amended bullying policy JICK.
summary: Approved retaining $1,250,000 of the year-end balance in the contingency fund; the minutes say $533,811 will be returned to taxpayers. Approved amended Policy JICK on student safety and bullying after waiving the second reading. Also adopted 2026-2027 goals covering contracts, policy, finance, facilities, curriculum, and communications.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the August 11, 2026 minutes, a $2,968,882.79 manifest, payroll and expense amounts, and three staff nominations, 7-0.
Approved Goal 1, Contract Negotiations, as presented, 7-0.
Approved Goal 2, Policy Review, as revised, 7-0.
Approved Goal 5, State Legislation, as presented, 7-0.
Approved Goal 7, Curriculum and Assessment, as presented, 7-0.
Approved retaining $1,250,000 in the contingency fund from the FY26 year-end balance, 7-0; the minutes state $533,811 will be returned to taxpayers.
Approved waiving the second reading limit and approving amended Policy JICK, Student Safety and Violence Prevention-Bullying, 7-0.
Approved changing the September 8, 2026 meeting to September 9, 2026, 7-0.
